files..work/inventory/spec.md:
# Search and export

**Status:** accepted

The agreed work includes name search and CSV export. Inputs are validated.

## Name search

search_items(items, query) returns case-insensitive substring matches in input order. An empty query returns all items. Inventory names are assumed to contain ASCII characters only, so lowercase comparison was accepted.

## CSV export

export_rows(items) returns CSV text with name,quantity headings, input order, standard CSV quoting and LF line endings. Empty input returns a header-only CSV. Export is independent of search. File writing and interfaces are excluded.
